**Rules.** Copy every file verbatim: do not restyle, rename classes, reformat, "improve", convert to another styling approach (CSS modules, styled-components, inline styles) or add npm packages. React and Tailwind CSS v4 only. Keep `'use client'` lines where they are. If a file already exists with identical contents, leave it. ## Specification

### Component: Timeline

Events in order along a connector line, optionally grouped by day. Presentational, Server Component–safe.

#### Anatomy
```
<Timeline>                    <ol class="ui-timeline">
  <TimelineGroup label>       <li class="ui-timeline-group"><h3 class="ui-timeline-group-label"/><ol class="ui-timeline-group-list">
    <TimelineItem tone marker markerType>
                              <li class="ui-timeline-item" [data-tone]>
                                <span class="ui-timeline-marker" data-kind="dot|icon|avatar">…</span>
                                <div class="ui-timeline-content">
      <TimelineHeader>          <div class="ui-timeline-header">
        <TimelineTitle />       <div class="ui-timeline-title">
        <TimelineTime />        <time class="ui-timeline-time">
      <TimelineDescription />   <p class="ui-timeline-description">
```
Groups are optional; items can sit directly in `Timeline`.

#### Props
- `TimelineItem`: `tone` — `default` · `success` · `warning` · `destructive` · `info`; `marker` (node; omit for a dot); `markerType` — `icon` (wrap in tinted circle, default) · `avatar` (leave bare, 24px `Avatar size="xs"`).
- `TimelineGroup`: `label` (node), `as` (heading element, default `h3`).
- `TimelineTime`: pass `dateTime` (ISO 8601).

#### Visual rules
- Marker column 1.5rem, gap .75rem; marker height 1.5rem. Items separated by `padding-bottom: 1.5rem` (none on the last).
- Connector: 1px `--ui-border`, from `marker + .25rem` down to `.25rem` above the next marker, centred under the marker; none after the last item.
- Dot: .5rem circle, `--ui-border-strong` (neutral) or the tone fill, 4px ring in `--ui-background` so the line appears to pass behind it.
- Icon marker: 1.5rem circle, 1px border mixed from the tone, fill `color-mix(tone 12%, background)`, icon .875rem in the tone's `-text` colour.
- Title 14px/500; time 12px muted, tabular-nums, nowrap; description 14px muted. Header wraps on narrow widths.
- Group label 12px/500 muted.

#### Motion
- Each item uses `var(--animate-rise)` on mount. Reduced motion: shortened to 1ms.

#### Accessibility
- Real ordered lists (`ol > li`); groups nest a labelled list in one `li`.
- `<time datetime>` for times. Dot markers are `aria-hidden`.
- Status is not conveyed by colour alone: the outcome must be in the text.

#### Acceptance checks
- Every item except the last has a 1px connector; the last has none.
- Tone changes the marker colour; default dot is neutral.
- Groups render their label as a heading and their items in a nested list.
- No serious axe violations in light and dark.

### `ui/components/timeline/timeline.tsx`

```tsx
import { forwardRef, type HTMLAttributes, type LiHTMLAttributes, type OlHTMLAttributes, type ReactNode, type TimeHTMLAttributes } from 'react';
import { cn } from '../../lib/cn';

export type TimelineTone = 'default' | 'success' | 'warning' | 'destructive' | 'info';

/**
 * Timeline — events in order, joined by a connector line. Server Component–safe.
 * A flat `<ol>`; wrap items in `TimelineGroup` to split them by day.
 */
export const Timeline = forwardRef<HTMLOListElement, OlHTMLAttributes<HTMLOListElement>>(function Timeline(
  { className, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  return <ol ref={ref} className={cn('ui-timeline', className)} {...props} />;
});

export interface TimelineGroupProps extends LiHTMLAttributes<HTMLLIElement> {
  /** The group heading, usually a day: "Today", "Yesterday", "21 November 2026". */
  label: ReactNode;
  /** Heading element. Default `h3`. */
  as?: 'h2' | 'h3' | 'h4' | 'h5' | 'h6' | 'div';
}

/** A labelled run of items inside a `Timeline` (one `<li>` holding a heading and a nested list). */
export const TimelineGroup = forwardRef<HTMLLIElement, TimelineGroupProps>(function TimelineGroup(
  { label, as: Tag = 'h3', className, children, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  return (
    <li ref={ref} className={cn('ui-timeline-group', className)} {...props}>
      <Tag className="ui-timeline-group-label">{label}</Tag>
      <ol className="ui-timeline-group-list">{children}</ol>
    </li>
  );
});

export interface TimelineItemProps extends LiHTMLAttributes<HTMLLIElement> {
  /** Colours the marker: `default` is neutral; the rest are status tones. Default `default`. */
  tone?: TimelineTone;
  /**
   * What sits on the line. Omit for a dot. Pass an `Icon` (it is put in a 24px tinted circle) or a 24px
   * `Avatar size="xs"` (kept as is). Use `markerType` to say which.
   */
  marker?: ReactNode;
  /** How `marker` is presented: `icon` wraps it in a tinted circle, `avatar` leaves it bare. Default `icon`. */
  markerType?: 'icon' | 'avatar';
}

/** One event: a marker on the line and its content (`TimelineHeader`, `TimelineDescription`…). */
export const TimelineItem = forwardRef<HTMLLIElement, TimelineItemProps>(function TimelineItem(
  { tone = 'default', marker, markerType = 'icon', className, children, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  const kind = marker ? markerType : 'dot';
  return (
    <li ref={ref} className={cn('ui-timeline-item', className)} data-tone={tone === 'default' ? undefined : tone} {...props}>
      <span className="ui-timeline-marker" data-kind={kind} aria-hidden={kind === 'dot' ? true : undefined}>
        {marker ?? <span className="ui-timeline-dot" />}
      </span>
      <div className="ui-timeline-content">{children}</div>
    </li>
  );
});

/** Title and time on one line; wraps on narrow screens. */
export const TimelineHeader = forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>>(function TimelineHeader(
  { className, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  return <div ref={ref} className={cn('ui-timeline-header', className)} {...props} />;
});

export const TimelineTitle = forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>>(function TimelineTitle(
  { className, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  return <div ref={ref} className={cn('ui-timeline-title', className)} {...props} />;
});

/** A `<time>`. Pass `dateTime` (ISO 8601) so assistive tech and crawlers read the real value. */
export const TimelineTime = forwardRef<HTMLTimeElement, TimeHTMLAttributes<HTMLTimeElement>>(function TimelineTime(
  { className, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  return <time ref={ref} className={cn('ui-timeline-time', className)} {...props} />;
});

export const TimelineDescription = forwardRef<HTMLParagraphElement, HTMLAttributes<HTMLParagraphElement>>(function TimelineDescription(
  { className, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  return <p ref={ref} className={cn('ui-timeline-description', className)} {...props} />;
});
```

### `ui/lib/cn.ts`

```ts
/**
 * Join class names, skipping falsy values.
 * No tailwind-merge needed: ui-* classes live in Tailwind's `components`
 * layer, so any utility passed in `className` already wins.
 */
export type ClassValue = string | number | false | null | undefined;

export function cn(...classes: ClassValue[]): string {
  let out = '';
  for (const c of classes) {
    if (!c) continue;
    out = out ? `${out} ${c}` : String(c);
  }
  return out;
}
```

### `ui/styles/components/timeline.css`

```css
/* Timeline ----------------------------------------------------------------
   .ui-timeline (ol) > .ui-timeline-item (li) | .ui-timeline-group (li)
   Item: .ui-timeline-marker[data-kind="dot|icon|avatar"] + .ui-timeline-content
         tone via [data-tone="success|warning|destructive|info"]
   Content: .ui-timeline-header > -title, -time ; .ui-timeline-description
   The connector is the item's ::before, from below its marker to the next one.
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------ */

@layer components {
  .ui-timeline,
  .ui-timeline-group-list {
    --ui-tl-marker: 1.5rem;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    list-style: none;
  }
  .ui-timeline { display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
  .ui-timeline-group { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.75rem; padding-bottom: 1.5rem; }
  .ui-timeline-group:last-child { padding-bottom: 0; }
  .ui-timeline-group-label {
    margin: 0;
    font-size: var(--text-xs);
    line-height: var(--text-xs--line-height);
    font-weight: 500;
    letter-spacing: 0.02em;
    color: var(--ui-muted-foreground);
  }

  .ui-timeline-item {
    --ui-tl-tone: var(--ui-muted-foreground);
    --ui-tl-tone-text: var(--ui-muted-foreground);
    position: relative;
    display: grid;
    grid-template-columns: var(--ui-tl-marker) minmax(0, 1fr);
    column-gap: 0.75rem;
    padding-bottom: 1.5rem;
    animation: var(--animate-rise);
  }
  .ui-timeline-item:last-child { padding-bottom: 0; }
  .ui-timeline-item[data-tone="success"] { --ui-tl-tone: var(--ui-success); --ui-tl-tone-text: var(--ui-success-text); }
  .ui-timeline-item[data-tone="warning"] { --ui-tl-tone: var(--ui-warning); --ui-tl-tone-text: var(--ui-warning-text); }
  .ui-timeline-item[data-tone="destructive"] { --ui-tl-tone: var(--ui-destructive); --ui-tl-tone-text: var(--ui-destructive-text); }
  .ui-timeline-item[data-tone="info"] { --ui-tl-tone: var(--ui-info); --ui-tl-tone-text: var(--ui-info-text); }

  /* Connector */
  .ui-timeline-item:not(:last-child)::before {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    top: calc(var(--ui-tl-marker) + 0.25rem);
    bottom: 0.25rem;
    left: calc(var(--ui-tl-marker) / 2 - 0.5px);
    width: 1px;
    background-color: var(--ui-border);
  }

  .ui-timeline-marker {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    width: var(--ui-tl-marker);
    height: var(--ui-tl-marker);
  }
  .ui-timeline-dot {
    width: 0.5rem;
    height: 0.5rem;
    border-radius: 9999px;
    background-color: var(--ui-tl-tone);
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px var(--ui-background);
  }
  .ui-timeline-item:not([data-tone]) .ui-timeline-dot { background-color: var(--ui-border-strong); }
  .ui-timeline-marker[data-kind="icon"] {
    border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-tl-tone) 35%, var(--ui-border));
    border-radius: 9999px;
    background-color: color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-tl-tone) 12%, var(--ui-background));
    color: var(--ui-tl-tone-text);
  }
  .ui-timeline-marker[data-kind="icon"] > svg { width: 0.875rem; height: 0.875rem; }
  .ui-timeline-marker[data-kind="avatar"] { border-radius: 9999px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--ui-background); }

  .ui-timeline-content { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.125rem; min-width: 0; }
  .ui-timeline-header {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    align-items: baseline;
    justify-content: space-between;
    column-gap: 0.75rem;
    row-gap: 0;
    min-height: var(--ui-tl-marker);
    padding-top: 0.125rem;
  }
  .ui-timeline-title {
    font-size: var(--text-base);
    line-height: var(--text-base--line-height);
    font-weight: 500;
    color: var(--ui-foreground);
  }
  .ui-timeline-time {
    font-size: var(--text-xs);
    line-height: var(--text-xs--line-height);
    color: var(--ui-muted-foreground);
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
    white-space: nowrap;
  }
  .ui-timeline-description {
    margin: 0;
    font-size: var(--text-base);
    line-height: var(--text-base--line-height);
    color: var(--ui-muted-foreground);
  }
}
```

### `ui/icons/icon.tsx`

```tsx
import { forwardRef, type SVGProps } from 'react';
import { cn } from '../lib/cn';
import { iconPaths, type IconName } from './paths';

export interface IconProps extends Omit<SVGProps<SVGSVGElement>, 'ref'> {
  /** Icon shape. */
  name: IconName;
  /** Pixel size (width and height). Default 16. */
  size?: number | string;
  /** Stroke width. Default 1.75. */
  strokeWidth?: number;
  /** Accessible label. Without it the icon is decorative (aria-hidden). */
  label?: string;
}

/**
 * Built-in stroke icon. Inherits `currentColor`.
 *   <Icon name="check" />   <Icon name="search" size={20} label="Search" />
 * Server Component–safe.
 */
export const Icon = forwardRef<SVGSVGElement, IconProps>(function Icon(
  { name, size = 16, strokeWidth = 1.75, label, className, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  return (
    <svg
      ref={ref}
      xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
      viewBox="0 0 24 24"
      width={size}
      height={size}
      fill="none"
      stroke="currentColor"
      strokeWidth={strokeWidth}
      strokeLinecap="round"
      strokeLinejoin="round"
      aria-hidden={label ? undefined : true}
      aria-label={label}
      role={label ? 'img' : undefined}
      focusable="false"
      className={cn('ui-icon', className)}
      // Static, library-owned SVG markup — never user input.
      dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: iconPaths[name] }}
      {...props}
    />
  );
});

export { iconPaths, type IconName };
```

## Usage

**Deploy activity** — from the docs (`apps/docs/examples/timeline/deploys.tsx`), imports rewritten to `@/ui/...`:

```tsx
import { Avatar, AvatarFallback } from '@/ui/components/avatar';
import { Badge } from '@/ui/components/badge';
import { Timeline, TimelineDescription, TimelineGroup, TimelineHeader, TimelineItem, TimelineTime, TimelineTitle } from '@/ui/components/timeline';
import { Icon } from '@/ui/icons/icon';

export default function TimelineDeploys() {
  return (
    <Timeline className="w-full max-w-lg" aria-label="Deploy activity">
      <TimelineGroup label="Today">
        <TimelineItem tone="success" marker={<Icon name="circle-check" />}>
          <TimelineHeader>
            <TimelineTitle>Deployed to production</TimelineTitle>
            <TimelineTime dateTime="2026-11-24T14:32">2:32 pm</TimelineTime>
          </TimelineHeader>
          <TimelineDescription>
            <code className="font-mono text-xs">a3f9c21</code> “Fix invoice rounding” went live in 48 s.
          </TimelineDescription>
        </TimelineItem>
        <TimelineItem tone="destructive" marker={<Icon name="circle-x" />}>
          <TimelineHeader>
            <TimelineTitle>Preview build failed</TimelineTitle>
            <TimelineTime dateTime="2026-11-24T13:05">1:05 pm</TimelineTime>
          </TimelineHeader>
          <TimelineDescription>
            Type error in <code className="font-mono text-xs">billing/summary.tsx</code>. Retried automatically.
          </TimelineDescription>
        </TimelineItem>
        <TimelineItem
          marker={
            <Avatar size="xs">
              <AvatarFallback>AR</AvatarFallback>
            </Avatar>
          }
          markerType="avatar"
        >
          <TimelineHeader>
            <TimelineTitle>Amina Rahman requested a review</TimelineTitle>
            <TimelineTime dateTime="2026-11-24T10:18">10:18 am</TimelineTime>
          </TimelineHeader>
          <TimelineDescription>
            Pull request #482{' '}
            <Badge variant="info" size="sm">
              Review
            </Badge>
          </TimelineDescription>
        </TimelineItem>
      </TimelineGroup>
      <TimelineGroup label="Yesterday">
        <TimelineItem tone="warning" marker={<Icon name="triangle-alert" />}>
          <TimelineHeader>
            <TimelineTitle>Rollback to v2.14.3</TimelineTitle>
            <TimelineTime dateTime="2026-11-23T17:40">5:40 pm</TimelineTime>
          </TimelineHeader>
          <TimelineDescription>Error rate rose above 2% after v2.14.4, so the release was reverted.</TimelineDescription>
        </TimelineItem>
        <TimelineItem tone="success">
          <TimelineHeader>
            <TimelineTitle>Deployed v2.14.4 to staging</TimelineTitle>
            <TimelineTime dateTime="2026-11-23T15:12">3:12 pm</TimelineTime>
          </TimelineHeader>
        </TimelineItem>
        <TimelineItem>
          <TimelineHeader>
            <TimelineTitle>Environment variable updated</TimelineTitle>
            <TimelineTime dateTime="2026-11-23T09:30">9:30 am</TimelineTime>
          </TimelineHeader>
          <TimelineDescription>STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET was rotated by Tomás Herrera.</TimelineDescription>
        </TimelineItem>
      </TimelineGroup>
    </Timeline>
  );
}
```
